title: What came between Siege of Orléans and Battle of Meung-sur-Loire?
question: What came between Siege of Orléans and Battle of Meung-sur-Loire?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Siege of Orléans (1428) to Battle of Meung-sur-Loire (1429): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
